blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Generating physically based rendering (PBR) texture maps for a 3D mesh from a single reference image is highly ambiguous, as the observed appearance entangles material identity, surface reflectance, and illumination. While current generative methods produce realistic albedo maps, they still struggle to infer accurate metallic and roughness attributes for relighting. We present UltraTex, a cascaded multi-view framework that moves beyond appearance matching by integrating physical knowledge into multi-view diffusion-based PBR generation. UltraTex first jointly predicts albedo and world-space shading normals to generate more detailed albedo maps, and then predicts metallic-roughness (MR) maps conditioned on the generated albedo, reference image, and material semantic priors. To inject material semantics, a lightweight adapter transforms hidden-layer features of a vision-language model (VLM) into intrinsic material representation tokens, providing part-level knowledge anchors for MR estimation. To model material-light interaction, photometric representation alignment guides intermediate diffusion features toward ground-truth material renderings under controlled lighting. This makes metallic and roughness variations observable through highlight intensity, specular sharpness, and local reflectance contrast, providing stronger guidance for fine-grained material prediction without explicit lighting supervision. Extensive experiments show that UltraTex generates high-quality textures and outperforms existing open-source and commercial methods in visual fidelity, material accuracy, and physical plausibility.
blocks.zh: 从单一的参考图像中生成一个3D网格的物理渲染(PBR)纹理图非常模糊,因为观测到的外观缠绕了物质身份,表面反射,以及照明. 虽然目前的基因方法产生了现实的反照率图,但它们仍然难以推断出准确的金属和粗糙度属性来重新点亮. 我们介绍UltraTex,这是一个级联的多视图框架,通过将物理知识整合到基于多视图传播的PBR生成中,超越外观匹配. UltraTex公司首先联合预测反照率和世界空间阴影常态,以生成更详细的反照率地图,然后预测以生成反照率为条件的金属槽(MR)地图,参考图像,以及材料语义学前传. 为了注入材料语义,一个轻量级适配器将视觉语言模型(VLM)的隐藏层特征转化为内在的物质表示符,为MR估计提供了部分层次的知识锚. 为了模拟材料与光的相互作用,光度表示对齐将中间扩散特征引导到受控照明下的地面真实材料渲染。 这使得金属和粗糙度的变化通过突出强度、光谱锋利度以及局部反射对比而明显可见,为未经明确照明监督的精细材料预测提供了更强有力的指导。 广泛的实验表明,UltraTex在视觉忠贞性,物质精度,和物理可信度方面产生高质量的纹理,并且超越现有的开源和商业方法.

blocks.en: 1. Introduction
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 导言

blocks.en:
Physically based rendering (PBR) is the industry standard for material representation of 3D assets in games, films, and AR/VR ( Burley, 2012 ; Pharr et al., 2016 ) .
PBR texture maps separate visible appearance from intrinsic material attributes, enabling assets to respond plausibly under different lighting conditions.
While albedo defines the base color of a surface, realistic relighting depends critically on properties such as metallic and roughness.
These attributes describe physical reflectance behavior rather than directly observable image signals, making high-quality PBR texture authoring a labor-intensive process that still relies heavily on expert-driven workflows ( Adobe Systems Inc., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh:
物理渲染(PBR)是3D资产在游戏,电影,以及AR/VR中物质表现的行业标准(Burley,2012年;Phar et al.,2016年).
PBR纹理图将可见的外观与内在的物质属性区分开来,使资产能够在不同的照明条件下作出合理的反应.
虽然反照率定义了表面的底色,但现实的再照关键取决于金属和粗糙度等特性.
这些属性描述的是物理反射行为而不是直接可观测的图像信号,使得高质量的PBR纹理作者仍然严重依赖专家驱动的工作流程(Adobe Systems Inc., 2024).

blocks.en:
Generating PBR texture maps for a 3D mesh from a single reference image is therefore highly ambiguous.
The observed appearance entangles material identity, surface reflectance, geometry, and illumination.
For example, a bright region in the input may arise from polished metal, glossy dielectric coating, baked illumination, or a local color pattern.
This ambiguity is especially severe for metallic–roughness (MR) estimation, where the desired outputs are abstract intrinsic maps rather than natural RGB images.
blocks.zh:
因此,从单一的参考图像中生成一个3D网格的PBR纹理图非常模糊.
观测到的外观缠绕着物质身份,表面反射,几何,以及照明.
例如,输入中的亮度区域可能来自抛光金属,光滑的二电涂层,烘烤的照明,或者局部的颜色图案.
这种模糊性对于金属色度(MR)估计来说特别严重,因为所期望的输出是抽象的内在地图而不是自然的RGB图像.

blocks.en:
Early inverse-rendering methods reduce this ambiguity by using controlled capture setups, such as co-located flash lighting, to expose physical cues like specular highlights ( Guo et al., 2021 ; Ma et al., 2021 ; Bao et al., 2025 ) .
Although effective in constrained environments, these methods do not generalize well to arbitrary in-the-wild images.
Recent generative approaches instead leverage powerful image-domain priors from diffusion models ( Rombach et al., 2022 ; Esser et al., 2024 ; BlackForestLabs, 2024 ) and multi-view generation techniques ( Shi et al., 2023 ; Huang et al., 2024a ; Team, 2025a ; Seed3D, 2026 ) to synthesize multi-view texture or PBR images, which are then reprojected onto the mesh surface to construct texture maps.
While this paradigm has substantially improved albedo generation, it remains unreliable for intrinsic MR prediction.
Existing methods often assign metallic values to incorrect regions or produce overly conservative roughness maps with limited fine-scale variation.
These failures indicate that strong appearance priors alone are insufficient: the model must also understand what each object part is made of and how its material should respond to light.
blocks.zh:
早期的反射方法通过使用控制捕获设置,如合用位置的闪光灯来暴露像光谱亮点这样的物理提示来减少这种模糊性(Guo等人,2021年;Ma等人,2021年;Bao等人,2025年).
这些方法虽然在受限环境中有效,但并不很好地概括为任意的内乱图像.
最近的遗传学方法反而利用了传播模型(Rombach等人,2022年;Esser等人,2024年;BlackForestLabs,2024年)和多视图生成技术(Shi等人,2023年;Huang等人,2024年a年;Team,2025年a年;Seed3D,2026年)的强大图像领域前传,合成多视图纹理或PBR图像,然后将其重新投射到网格表面,以构建纹理图.
虽然这种范式大大改善了反照率生成,但对内在的MR预测来说仍然是不可靠的.
现有方法往往将金属值分配给不正确的区域,或制作过于保守的粗糙度图,细度变化有限。
这些失败表明,仅强的外观前缀是不够的:模型还必须了解每个物体部分的构成以及其材料应如何对光作出反应.

blocks.en:
Professional PBR creation follows this reasoning naturally: artists infer material maps by considering asset style, part-wise material composition, surface structure, and illumination behavior, rather than matching pixels alone.
We argue that high-fidelity PBR generation requires aligning such physical knowledge with the generative process.
This alignment can be achieved in two complementary ways.
First, physical knowledge can be injected as conditioning priors for material semantics.
Vision-language models are well suited for this role, as their hidden representations encode rich world knowledge and semantic reasoning from large-scale image-text pretraining; however, an adapter is needed to translate them into diffusion-compatible material tokens.
Second, physical knowledge can guide learning through training objectives.
Since metallic and roughness maps are abstract intrinsic parameters whose effects become visible only after interacting with albedo, geometry, and illumination, MR generation should be supervised in a photometric representation space where controlled-light renderings reveal material-light responses.
blocks.zh:
专业的PBR创作自然遵循这一推理: 艺术家通过考虑资产风格,部分的材质组成,表面结构,以及照明行为,而不是单独匹配像素来推断材料地图.
我们主张,高可靠性的PBR生成需要使这种物理知识与基因过程保持一致.
这种配合可以通过两种相辅相成的方式实现。
首先,物理知识可以作为材料语义的前提前缀注入.
视觉语言模型非常适合这个角色,因为其隐藏的表达方式将丰富的世界知识和语义推理从大规模的图像文本预训中编码出来;然而,需要一个适配器来将其转化为可传播的兼容物证.
第二,实际知识可以指导通过培训目标进行学习。
由于金属和粗糙度图是抽象的内在参数,只有在与反照、几何和光线相互作用后,其效果才会显现出来,所以MR生成应在一个光度表示空间中进行监督,在这种空间中,可控光渲染显示材料光的反应。

blocks.en:
To this end, we introduce UltraTex, a cascaded multi-view framework for high-quality PBR texture generation from a single reference image and an input mesh.
UltraTex first jointly predicts albedo and world-space shading normals to obtain detailed albedo maps, and then predicts MR maps conditioned on the generated albedo, reference-image features, and material semantic priors.
For material-semantic conditioning, we introduce a VLM-guided intrinsic material adapter that transforms hidden-layer vision-language features into intrinsic material tokens, providing part-level knowledge anchors for MR estimation.
For photometric guidance, we propose photometric representation alignment, which guides intermediate MR diffusion features toward visual representations of ground-truth materials rendered under controlled lighting.
This rendered RGB space reveals fine-grained MR variations through highlight intensity, specular sharpness, and local reflectance contrast, providing stronger guidance without explicit lighting supervision.
blocks.zh:
为此,我们引入了UltraTex,从一个单一的参考图像和一个输入网格,为高质量PBR纹理生成的级联多视图框架.
UltraTex首先联合预测反照率和世界空间阴影常态,以获得详细的反照率地图,然后预测以生成反照率为条件的MR地图,参考图像特征,以及材料语义前传.
对于材料语义调节,我们引入了VLM制导的内在材料适配器,将隐藏层视觉语言特征转化为内在物质符号,为MR估算提供部分层次的知识锚.
关于测光指导,我们提议进行测光表示对齐,指导中间MR扩散特性,以可视化表示在受控照明下提供的地面真实材料。
这使得RGB空间通过亮度强度,光谱锐度以及局部反射对比,揭示出细纹MR的变异,在没有明确照明监管的情况下提供更强的指引.

blocks.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that UltraTex generates high-quality PBR textures and substantially outperforms state-of-the-art open-source and commercial methods in visual fidelity, material accuracy, and physical plausibility.
blocks.zh: 广泛的实验表明,UltraTex生成高质量的PBR纹理,在视觉忠诚度,物质准确度和物理可信度方面大大超过最先进的开源和商业方法.

blocks.en: In summary, we make the following contributions: • To the best of our knowledge, we present the first diffusion-based PBR texture generation framework that explicitly aligns physical knowledge through material-semantic conditioning and photometric representation guidance. • We introduce a VLM-guided intrinsic material adapter that translates hidden-layer vision-language features into material-aware tokens, injecting part-wise semantic priors into MR generation. • We propose photometric representation alignment, which guides intermediate MR diffusion features with controlled-light material renderings to capture fine-grained material-light interactions. • Extensive experiments demonstrate that UltraTex substantially outperforms existing open-source and commercial methods in visual fidelity, material accuracy, and physical plausibility.
blocks.zh: 总而言之,我们作出以下贡献: 根据我们的知识,我们提出第一个基于传播的PBR纹理生成框架,通过材料语义调节和光度表示指导明确协调物理知识。 我们引入了VLM导引的内在材料适配器,将隐藏的层次视觉语言特征翻译为物质感知符号,将部分的语义前缀注入MR代. ^ 我们提议进行光度表示对齐,指导中间MR扩散特性,采用可控光材料渲染,以捕捉精细的光材料相互作用。 • 广泛的实验表明,UltraTex在视觉忠诚、材料准确性和物理可信性方面大大超过现有的开源和商业方法。

blocks.en: 2. Related Work
blocks.zh: 2. 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1. Texture Generation
blocks.zh: 2.1. 质地生成

blocks.en:
Foundation models have opened new directions for automating texture generation in 3D content creation.
Early methods adopt optimization-based paradigms, using Score Distillation Sampling (SDS) ( Poole et al., 2023 ) to distill priors from pretrained 2D diffusion models into 3D assets ( Poole et al., 2022 ; Lin et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2023 ; Po and Wetzstein, 2024 ; Metzer et al., 2022 ; Chen et al., 2023b ; Khalid et al., 2022 ; Michel et al., 2021 ; Chen et al., 2022 ) .
However, iterative optimization over renderings is costly and often produces over-saturated textures or artifacts that limit practical use.
blocks.zh:
基础模型为3D内容创建中的纹理生成自动化开启了新的方向.
早期的方法采用基于优化的范式,使用分数分馏取样法(SDS)(Poole等人,2023年)从预先训练的2D扩散模型中将前科提炼成3D资产(Poole等人,2022年;Lin等人,2023年;Wang等人,2023年;Po和Wetzstein,2023年)。 2024; Metzer等人,2022;Chen等人,2023b;Khalid等人,2022;Michel等人,2021;Chen等人,2022).
然而,对渲染的迭代优化成本高昂,往往会产生限制实际用途的过度饱和纹理或文物.

blocks.en:
Feed-forward approaches explored progressive inpainting across pre-defined views conditioned on explicit 3D attributes ( Yu et al., 2023 ; Bensadoun et al., 2024 ; Cao et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2024b ) .
However, the geometric fidelity is frequently compromised by the cross-view latent synchronization. Alternatively, to bypass such occlusion and alignment issues, other methods directly target the UV space ( Yu et al., 2023 ; Zeng et al., 2024 ; Bensadoun et al., 2024 ; Yu et al., 2024 ) .
Yet, the topological fragmentation inherent to UV parameterizations severely degrades the generative capacity of 2D diffusion models, hindering high-fidelity synthesis.
blocks.zh:
Feed-forward方法探索了以明确的3D属性为条件的跨预先定义观点的渐进涂装(Yu等人,2023年;Bensadoun等人,2024年;Cao等人,2023年;Liu等人,2024年b).
然而,几何忠诚度经常因交叉视野潜在同步而受损. 或者,为了绕过这种隔离和对齐问题,其他方法直接针对紫外线空间(Yu等人,2023年;Zeng等人,2024年;Bensadoun等人,2024年;Yu等人,2024年)。
然而,紫外线参数化所固有的地形分裂使2D扩散模型的基因容量严重下降,阻碍了高真性合成.

blocks.en:
Recent methods ( Huang et al., 2024a ; Zhao et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025 ; Yeo et al., 2026 ; He et al., 2026 ) incorporate multi-view attention mechanisms ( Li et al., 2024 ; Kant et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2024c ; Shi et al., 2023 ; Wang and Shi, 2023 ; Feng et al., 2025 ) to generate globally consistent textures while respecting 3D geometry.
However, they mainly target appearance texturing, producing either albedo maps or illumination-baked textures without intrinsic material attributes required for physically based relighting.
blocks.zh:
近代方法(黄某1等人,2024a;赵某1等人,2025;刘某1等人,2025;叶某1等人,2026;贺某1等人,2026)纳入多视角关注机制(李某1等人,2024;康某1等人,2024;黄某1等人,2024c;史某1等人,2023;王某1,2023). 2023; Feng et al., 2025))生成全球一致的纹理,同时尊重3D几何.
然而,它们主要针对外观纹理,产生反照率图或没有物理重光所需的内在物质属性的照明纹理.

blocks.en: Another line of work performs texture generation directly in native 3D space ( Lai et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2026 ; Zeng et al., 2025 ; Xiang et al., 2025 ) . These methods directly generate complete surface textures in 3D space, providing inherent geometric consistency while avoiding view-projection artifacts such as edge bleeding. However, the scarcity of high-quality 3D data with high-resolution textures limits fine-detail modeling.
blocks.zh: 另一行工作直接在本地立体空间进行纹理生成(Lai等人,2025年;Chen等人,2026年;Zeng等人,2025年;Xiang等人,2025年)。 这些方法直接在3D空间中产生完整的表面纹理,提供了固有的几何一致性,同时避免了边缘流血等视图投影文物. 然而,缺乏高分辨率纹理的高质量3D数据限制了精细的模型制作.

Figure 2. Overall pipeline of UltraTex. UltraTex adopts a cascaded two-stage multi-view diffusion pipeline.
Stage 1 jointly predicts albedo maps and world-space shading normals from the reference image and multi-view geometry normals.
Stage 2 predicts metallic-roughness (MR) maps (where purple and green represent roughness and metallic, respectively) conditioned on the generated albedo, reference-image features, and VLM-derived intrinsic material tokens.
For MR training, photometric representation alignment uses a frozen visual encoder to extract representations from controlled-light material renderings, and an MLP aligns intermediate diffusion features to this photometric representation space via ℒ REPA \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{REPA}} .

blocks.en: 2.2. PBR Texture Generation
blocks.zh: 2.2. PBR 纹理生成

blocks.en:
Building upon texture synthesis, recent methods extend pretrained diffusion models to PBR material generation.
Early works incorporate BRDF formulations into SDS optimization to infer material properties ( Chen et al., 2023a ; Zhang et al., 2024a ; Liu et al., 2024a ; Youwang et al., 2024a ; Wu et al., 2023 ; Xu et al., 2023 ; Yeh et al., 2024 ) , but often struggle to decompose lighting and surface reflectance, leading to unrealistic or flat results.
blocks.zh:
在纹理合成的基础上,最近的方法将预先训练的传播模型扩展到PBR材料生成.
早期工程将BRDF配方纳入SS优化,以推断材料性质(Chen等人,2023a); Zhang等人,2024a;Liu等人,2024a;Youwang等人,2024a;Wu等人,2023;Xu等人,2023;Yeh等人,2024),但经常努力分解照明和表面反射,导致不切实际或平整的结果.

blocks.en:
To enhance spatial alignment and material accuracy, subsequent approaches either employ iterative latent synchronization ( Huang et al., 2024b ; Zhang et al., 2024c ) or leverage LLMs for retrieval-augmented generation ( Zhang et al., 2024b ; Dang et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Fang et al., 2024 ; Wei et al., 2025 ) .
Despite this, these methods primarily transfer generative priors to the PBR task without end-to-end training on large-scale PBR datasets, which fundamentally constrains their generalization ability.
blocks.zh:
为提高空间对齐和材料准确性,以后的办法要么采用迭代潜在同步(Huang等人,2024b); Zhang等人,2024c)或杠杆LLMs用于回收加固生成(Zhang等人,2024b;Dang等人,2024;Wang等人,2024;Fang等人,2024;Wei等人,2025).
尽管如此,这些方法主要在不进行大规模PBR数据集的端到端训练的情况下转移PBR任务的基因前科,从根本上限制了其通化能力.

blocks.en:
A recent line of work fine-tunes image or video models to predict multi-channel PBR maps ( He et al., 2025 ; Zhu et al., 2024 ; Vainer et al., 2024 ; Vecchio et al., 2024 ; Hasselgren et al., 2026 ; Ma et al., 2025 ; Munkberg et al., 2025 ; Yuan et al., 2025 ) .
These methods mainly transfer appearance-generation priors to intrinsic material prediction through pixel-level reconstruction losses.
While scalable, this transfer does not directly resolve the ambiguity of MR estimation, where metallic and roughness are latent material properties rather than observable appearance.
As a result, these models remain biased toward appearance matching, leading to frequent ambiguity in intrinsic material decomposition.
In contrast, our method introduces explicit material reasoning from VLM world knowledge and representation-level photometric regularization to provide semantic and physical supervision for MR generation.
blocks.zh:
最近的工作线微调图像或视频模型,以预测多渠道的PBR地图(He等人,2025年;Zhu等人,2024年;Vainer等人,2024年;Vecchio等人,2024年;Hasselgren等人,2026年;Ma等人,2025年;Munkberg等人,2025年;袁等人,2025年)。
这些方法主要通过像素级重建损失将外观生成前期转移至内在的物质预测.
这种转移虽然可以扩展,但并不能直接解决MR估计的模糊性,因为金属和粗糙度是潜在的物质特性,而不是可观察到的外观。
因此,这些模型仍然偏向于外观匹配,导致内在物质分解中经常出现模糊.
与此相反,我们的方法从VLM世界知识中引入了明确的物质推理和表现层光度测定规范,为MR生成提供语义和物理监督.

blocks.en: 3. Method
blocks.zh: 3个 方法

blocks.en:
Given a single reference image and an input mesh, UltraTex generates cross-view consistent PBR texture maps through a cascaded two-stage multi-view diffusion pipeline (Fig. 2 ).
Stage 1 jointly predicts orthographic-view albedo maps and world-space shading normals from the reference image and multi-view geometry normals (Sec. 3.1 ).
Conditioned on the generated albedo, Stage 2 predicts metallic-roughness (MR) maps with a VLM-guided intrinsic material adapter (Sec. 3.2.1 ) and photometric representation alignment (Sec. 3.2.2 ).
Both stages are built upon an image diffusion backbone and are trained separately; following ( Team, 2025a ) , MR maps are represented as two channels of a single RGB image.
blocks.zh:
鉴于一个单一的参考图像和一个输入网格,UltraTex通过一个级联的两级多视图扩散管道(图2)生成一致的PBR纹理图.
第1阶段联合预测了从参考图像和多视图几何常态(Sec. 3.1 )得出的正反照率图和世界空间阴影常态.
以生成的反照率为条件,第2阶段用VLM制导的内在材料适配器(Sec. 3.2.1)和光度表示比对(Sec. 3.2.2.)预示金属弧度图。
两个阶段都建立在图像传播主干线上,并分别接受训练;之后(Team,2025a),MR地图作为单一RGB图像的两个通道来体现.

blocks.en:
Figure 3. VLM-guided intrinsic material adapter. A frozen VLM extracts hidden-layer visual features from rendered reference images, and a trainable adapter projects them into 1D intrinsic material tokens.
With the image diffusion model frozen, the adapter is trained to reconstruct ground-truth metallic and roughness maps by injecting these tokens into the denoising blocks.
The learned tokens encode part-aware material semantic priors and are used to guide MR generation.

随着图像传播模型的冻结,适配器通过将这些信使注入去声区块来进行重建地面真实金属和粗糙度图的培训.

blocks.en: 3.1.3. Joint Estimation of Shading Normal
blocks.zh: 3.1.3. 混合正常值的联合估计

blocks.en:
We introduce a computationally efficient scheme to jointly predict world-space shading normals ( 𝑺 \bm{S} ) alongside albedo maps.
This auxiliary prediction provides geometry-aware supervision for albedo generation, encouraging richer surface structure and high-frequency details.
blocks.zh:
我们引入了一个计算效率的方案,以联合预测世界空间阴影正常(S\bm{S})与反照率地图。
这种辅助预测为反照率生成提供了几何感知监督,鼓励更丰富的表面结构和高频细节.

blocks.en:
Why world-space shading normals? Unlike tangent-space normal or bump maps, which depend on local UV coordinates, world-space shading normals are expressed in a global coordinate frame and remain independent of UV parameterization.
This avoids the inconsistent tangent frames introduced by rotated or flipped UV islands, making normal prediction less prone to seams (Fig. 4 (a)).

这样可以避免由旋转或翻转的紫外线岛屿引入的不一致的切合框架,使正常预测更不易发生缝合(图4(a))。

blocks.en: 3.2. Multi-view MR Generation
blocks.zh: 3.2. 多视图MR世代

blocks.en:
Our multi-view MR generator follows the same MM-T/MV-T architecture as the albedo model in Sec. 3.1 , but replaces the geometry-normal condition with the Stage-1 albedo maps.
It further introduces two physical knowledge alignment modules for intrinsic material estimation: a VLM-guided intrinsic material adapter and photometric representation alignment.
blocks.zh:
我们的多视图 MR 生成器遵循与 Sec. 3.1 中的反照率模型相同的 MM-T/MV-T 架构,但以 Stage-1 反照率图取代几何常态.
它还为内在材料估计引入了两个物理知识协调模块:一个由VLM制导的内在材料适配器和光度表示协调。

blocks.en: 3.2.1. VLM-Guided Intrinsic Material Adapter
blocks.zh: 3.2.1. VLM - Guided Intrinsic 材料适应器

blocks.en:
Before training the multi-view MR generator, we train a VLM-guided intrinsic material adapter in a separate stage, as illustrated in Fig. 3 .
The goal is to translate material-aware visual knowledge from a frozen vision-language model (VLM) into diffusion-compatible intrinsic material tokens.
During this adapter training stage, both the VLM and the image diffusion model are kept frozen, and only the adapter is optimized.
blocks.zh:
如图3所示,在培训多视图 MR 生成器之前,我们将在单独的阶段培训一个VLM制导的内在材料适配器。
目标是将冷冻的视觉语言模型(VLM)中具有物质意识的视觉知识转化为可传播兼容的内在物质符号.
在这个适配器训练阶段,VLM和图像传播模型都保持冷冻状态,只有适配器被优化.

blocks.en:
Previous studies ( Neo et al., 2024 ; Kaduri et al., 2025 ) indicate that VLM hidden representations evolve progressively across layers: early layers capture raw visual features, whereas intermediate layers encode more abstract semantic and reasoning cues.
Since MR generation requires reasoning about intrinsic material properties rather than direct appearance transfer, we exploit intermediate VLM tokens extracted from the encoded reference image 𝑰 \bm{I} as a source of material-aware context.
Specifically, let 𝒱 m ​ ( 𝑰 ) ∈ ℝ P × d vlm \mathcal{V}_{m}(\bm{I})\in\mathbb{R}^{P\times d_{\text{vlm}}} denote the visual-token subsequence of the VLM hidden state at layer m m , where P P is the number of image patch tokens.
We select a set of intermediate layers ℳ \mathcal{M} and concatenate their visual tokens along the channel dimension: (9) 𝐇 ℳ vlm = concat m ∈ ℳ ⁡ [ 𝒱 m ​ ( 𝑰 ) ] ∈ ℝ P × | ℳ | ​ d vlm . \mathbf{H}^{\mathrm{vlm}}_{\mathcal{M}}=\operatorname{concat}_{m\in\mathcal{M}}\left[\mathcal{V}_{m}(\bm{I})\right]\in\mathbb{R}^{P\times|\mathcal{M}|d_{\text{vlm}}}.

由于MR生成需要关于内在物质属性的推理,而不是直接的外观转移,所以我们利用从编码的参考图像I\bm{I}中提取的中间VLM符号,作为材料意识上下文的来源.

The VLM token space is not directly compatible with the conditioning space of the image diffusion model.
We therefore introduce an Intrinsic Material Token Adapter 𝒜 \mathcal{A} , which projects 𝐇 ℳ vlm \mathbf{H}^{\mathrm{vlm}}_{\mathcal{M}} into 1D intrinsic material tokens: (10) 𝐓 mat = 𝒜 ⁡ ( 𝐇 ℳ vlm ) . \mathbf{T}_{\text{mat}}=\mathcal{A}\left(\mathbf{H}^{\mathrm{vlm}}_{\mathcal{M}}\right). We optimize the adapter with the standard flow-matching objective on rendered reference images paired with their ground-truth MR maps.
After training, the learned tokens encode part-aware material semantic priors and are used as conditional inputs for Stage-2 MR generation.

blocks.en: 3.2.2. Photometric Representation Alignment
blocks.zh: 3.2.2. 光度表示对齐

blocks.en:
Inspired by representation alignment methods such as REPA ( Yu et al., 2025 ) , we introduce photometric representation alignment to provide stronger guidance for MR generation.
Directly aligning raw MR maps with pretrained visual encoders is ill-posed, since encoders such as DINOv2 ( Oquab et al., 2023 ) and MAE ( He et al., 2022 ) are trained on natural images, while metallic and roughness maps are abstract intrinsic parameters.
blocks.zh:
受REPA(Yu等人,2025年)等代表配对方法的启发,我们引入了光度表示配对,为MR一代提供更强有力的指导.
直接将原始的MR地图与预先训练的视觉编码器对齐是不正确的,因为DINov2(Oquab等人,2023年)和MAE(He等人,2022年)等编码器都接受了自然图像的培训,而金属和粗糙度地图则是抽象的内在参数.

blocks.en:
To bridge this domain gap, we construct alignment targets in a photometrically meaningful RGB space.
For each training view, we render the ground-truth materials 𝐱 \mathbf{x} into an auxiliary photometric response 𝐱 pm \mathbf{x}_{\text{pm}} under a controlled point-light setup, where the light source is collocated with the camera.
The rendered response exposes material-light interactions, such as highlight intensity, specular sharpness, and local reflectance contrast, while remaining compatible with pretrained visual encoders.

blocks.en: 4. Experiments
blocks.zh: 4. 实验

blocks.en: We compare UltraTex against open-source and commercial state-of-the-art PBR generation methods through qualitative comparisons, quantitative metrics, and a user study in Sec. 4.2 , comprehensively examining both intrinsic PBR accuracy and human visual preference. We also ablate main factors of our architecture in Sec. 4.3 .
blocks.zh: 我们通过质量比较、定量度量和用户研究,将UltraTex与开源和商业最先进的PBR生成方法进行比较。 我们还淡化了我国在4.3区的建筑结构的主要因素。

blocks.en: 4.1. Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 4.1. 详细执行情况

blocks.en: 4.1.1. Dataset.

We curate a dataset of 130K objects from Objaverse-XL ( Deitke et al., 2023b ; Deitke et al., 2023a ) and TexVerse ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) .
For diversity, each object is rendered into 32 reference images under random cameras and environment maps. For supervision, we extract ground-truth PBR maps (albedo, metallic, roughness), normals (geometry, shading), and render photometric images across six 1024 2 1024^{2} orthogonal views. We provide more details in the supplementary.
blocks.zh:
我们对来自Objaverse-XL(Deitke等人,2023b;Deitke等人,2023a)和TexVerse(Zhang等人,2025年)的130K天体的数据集进行校验。
为了多样性,每个物体在随机摄像头和环境地图下被制成32个参考图像. 为了监督,我们提取地面真实的PBR地图(albedo,金属,粗糙度),正常的(几何,阴影度),并绘制6幅1024 2 1024\2}正视的光度图像。 我们在补充文件中提供了更多的细节。

blocks.en: 4.1.2. Training.

We use the intrinsic material token adapter to integrate the Qwen3.5-4B VLM ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) with our diffusion framework.
The adapter is a two-layer MLP with channel dimensions { 12288 , 4096 , 3072 } \{12288,4096,3072\} and an intermediate SiLU activation.
Hierarchical visual features are extracted from intermediate VLM layers ℳ = { 8 , 16 , 24 } \mathcal{M}=\{8,16,24\} .
Both the albedo and MR models initialize their DiT backbones from a pretrained text-to-image diffusion model.
The multi-view models are trained at a per-view resolution of 768 2 768^{2} .
Each model is trained on 32 NVIDIA A100 GPUs for about 2 days.
blocks.zh:
我们使用内在的材料符号适配器将Quen3.5-4B VLM(Quen Team,2026)与我们的传播框架融合.
适配器为双层MLP,通道尺寸为{12288,4096,3072}}#12288,4096,3072\},中间SiLU激活.
从中间 VLM 层 M = {8, 16, 24}\ mathcal{M}=\{8, 16, 24} 中提取出等级视觉特征 。
反照率和MR模型都从预先训练的文本到图像传播模型中初始化其DiT骨干.
多景模式通过768 2 768^{2}的每景解析法培训.
每个型号都通过32台NVIDIA A100 GPU进行约2天的培训.

blocks.en: 4.1.3. Inference.

At inference time, we first generate six-view albedo maps, which then condition the MR network to estimate corresponding metallic and roughness maps. All maps per view are upscaled to 1536 2 1536^{2} by a super-resolution module and mapped onto 4K UV textures. To ensure complete surface coverage, unobserved regions not captured by the orthogonal projections are inpainted using the novel view synthesis model from LumiTex ( Bao et al., 2026 ) (see original paper for details).
blocks.zh: 在推论时间,我们首先生成六景反照率图,然后以MR网络为条件来估计相应的金属和粗糙度图. 每个视图的所有地图都通过超解析模块被放大到1536 2 1536\},并映射到4K紫外线纹理上。 为确保完整的表面覆盖,未被正交预测所捕捉的未观测区域使用LumiTex(Bao等人,2026年)的新观点合成模型(详情见原始文件)进行涂抹。

blocks.en: 4.2.1. Baselines.

We compare UltraTex with representative open-source PBR texture synthesis methods, including Paint-it ( Youwang et al., 2024b ) , DreamMat ( Zhang et al., 2024a ) , Hunyuan3D v2.1 ( Team, 2025a ; Huang et al., 2025 ) , LumiTex ( Bao et al., 2026 ) , and TRELLIS.2 ( Xiang et al., 2025 ) .
We also compare against commercial methods, including Hunyuan3D v3.1, Hyper3D ( Hyper3D, 2026 ) , Meshy 6 ( Meshy, 2026 ) , and TripoAI v3.1 ( TripoAI, 2026 ) and Seed3D 2.0 ( Seed3D, 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
我们比较了UltraTex与具有代表性的开源PBR纹理合成方法,包括Paint-it(Youwang等人,2024年b),Dream Mat (Zhang等人,2024a),Hunyuan3D v2.1 (Team,2025a;Huang等人,2025),LumiTex (Bao等人,2026),以及TRELLIS.2 (Xiang等人,2025).
我们还比较了商业方法,包括Hunyuan3D v3.1,Hyper3D(Hyper3D,2026),Messy 6(Messy,2026),TripoAI v3.1(TripoAI,2026)和Seed3D 2.0(Seed3D,2026).

blocks.en: 4.2.2. Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: 4.2.2. 评价计量

blocks.en: To evaluate texture fidelity, we follow the protocol of Hunyuan3D ( Team, 2025a ; Team, 2025b ; Zhao et al., 2025 ) by employing FID ( Heusel et al., 2017 ) , CLIP-FID, and LPIPS ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) . For a more fine-grained assessment, we use CLIP Maximum-Mean Discrepancy (CMMD) ( Jayasumana et al., 2024 ) to measure detail diversity and CLIP-I ( Radford et al., 2021 ) for prompt alignment. Notably, all aforementioned perceptual and semantic metrics are computed exclusively on the albedo maps. For MR estimation, accuracy is validated via the MSE ( × 10 − 3 \times 10^{-3} ). We also conduct a user study to benchmark texture quality based on human preferences.
blocks.zh: 为了评价纹理忠贞度,我们遵循Hunyuan3D(Team,2025a;Team,2025b;Zhao等人,2025)的规程,使用FID(Heusel等人,2017年),CLIP-FID和LPIPS(Zhang等人,2018年). 为了进行更精细的评估,我们使用CLIP 最大 mean discovery(CMD)(Jayasumana等人,2024年)来测量细节多样性和CLIP-I(Radford等人,2021年)来快速对齐. 值得注意的是,上述所有概念和语义指标都是完全在反照率图上计算的。 对于MR估计,精确度通过MSE验证(×10−3\times 10×3}). 我们还进行用户研究,根据人类偏好确定纹理质量。

blocks.en: 4.2.3. Quantitative Results
blocks.zh: 4.2.3. 量化结果

blocks.en:
We quantitatively compare UltraTex with baselines on 152 held-out Objaverse-XL objects, using Blender-rendered GT assets as reference inputs and rendering outputs at 1024 2 1024^{2} resolution.
Except for MSE on MR attributes, all perceptual and semantic metrics are computed on rendered albedo/MR images, covering visual fidelity, semantic alignment, and PBR accuracy.
blocks.zh:
我们用UltraTex与152个悬浮Objaverse-XL物体的基线进行定量比较,使用Blender的GT资产作为参考投入,并以1024 2 1024 ^{2}分辨率提供产出。
除MR属性上的MSE外,所有知觉和语义度量度均根据渲染的反照率/MR图像计算,涵盖视觉忠诚度,语义校正度,以及PBR精度.

blocks.en:
As shown in Tab. 1 , our method consistently outperforms existing baselines across all metrics.
It achieves better FID and LPIPS for perceptual quality, lower CMMD for texture diversity, higher CLIP-I/CLIP-FID for semantic alignment, and the lowest MSE across PBR attributes, validating its superior physical accuracy.

Additionally, Table 3 further shows that our method outperforms both the state-of-the-art multi-view baseline (LumiTex) and the 3D-native baseline (TRELLIS.2) under environment relighting.
blocks.zh:
如附件1所示,我们的方法一贯超越所有衡量标准的现有基线。
它在知觉质量上实现了更好的FID和LPIPS,在纹理多样性上实现了较低的CMMD,在语义对齐上实现了更高的CLIP-I/CLIP-FID,在PBR属性上实现了最低的MSE,验证了其优越的物理精度.

此外,表3还表明,我们的方法在环境再照下,既超过了最先进的多视图基线(LumiTex),也超过了3D本地基线(TRELLIS.2)。

blocks.en:
To evaluate perceptual quality, we conduct a blind user study where 31 professional 3D modelers rate results from 1 to 5 based on overall rendering, albedo, roughness, and metallic fidelity.
UltraTex achieves the highest scores across all dimensions (Tab. 2 ) and substantially outperforms competitors in pairwise win rates (Fig. 5 ), demonstrating strong expert preference.
blocks.zh:
为了评价知觉质量,我们进行了盲目用户研究,根据总体渲染、反照率、粗糙度和金属纯度,31名专业三维模型师得出1至5分。
UltraTex在各个方面都取得了最高的分数(Tab. 2),在双向胜率(图5)上大大胜过竞争者,显示出专家的强烈偏好.

blocks.en: 4.2.4. Qualitative Results
blocks.zh: 4.2.4. 定性结果

blocks.en: We qualitatively compare UltraTex with recent open-source and commercial baselines for PBR texture generation. For test data, we generate reference images via Seedream 4.5 ( Seedream et al., 2025 ) , followed by mesh generation with Hunyuan3D v3.1, then apply each method for texture generation.
blocks.zh: 我们从质量上将UltraTex与PBR纹理生成最近的开源和商业基线进行比较。 对于测试数据,我们通过Seedream 4.5(Seedream et al., 2025)生成参考图像,然后用Hunyuan3D v3.1生成网格,然后应用每种方法生成纹理.

blocks.en:
As shown in Fig. 7 and 7 , existing methods like Hunyuan3D and Hyper3D often suffer from illumination leakage, producing albedo maps with baked-in lighting artifacts. Furthermore, most baselines have difficulty resolving intrinsic material ambiguity, frequently misclassifying metallic regions or producing over-smoothed roughness maps.
In contrast, by leveraging material knowledge and illumination cues, UltraTex consistently produces more accurate metallic estimates and fine-grained roughness details, while also delivering albedo maps with superior physical fidelity and structural richness.
blocks.zh:
如图7和图7所示,Hunyuan3D和Hyper3D等现有方法经常发生照明泄漏,用烘烤的照明文物制作反照率图. 此外,大多数基线都难以解决固有的材料模糊问题,常常对金属区域进行错误分类,或制作过于模糊的粗糙度图。
与此相反,UltraTex通过利用物质知识和照明提示,不断生成更准确的金属估计和精细的粗糙度细节,同时提供具有较高物理忠诚度和结构丰富的反照率图.

blocks.en: This advantage is especially evident in challenging cases (Fig. 8 ), including micro-scale roughness variations, oxidized or coated metals, and part-wise material changes, where baselines often fail. Furthermore, the diverse gallery in Fig. 18 demonstrates our model’s ability to produce physically plausible textures across a wide array of geometric complexities and material compositions.
blocks.zh: 这一优势在具有挑战性的案例(图8)中尤其明显,包括微尺度的粗糙度变化、氧化或涂层金属,以及部分偏移的物质变化,在这些案例中,基线往往失灵。 此外,图18的多样化画廊表明,我们的模型有能力通过各种几何复杂性和材料组成来制作物理上可信的纹理。

blocks.en: We further evaluate the generated PBR textures through relighting under diverse novel illumination conditions. As shown in Fig. 9 , the recovered material properties respond naturally to changes in lighting, producing consistent highlights, reflections, and surface appearance across different environments.
blocks.zh: 我们通过在各种新颖的照明条件下重新照明,进一步评估产生的PBR纹理。 如图9所示,回收的材料特性对照明的变化自然作出反应,在不同环境中产生一致的亮度、反射和表面外观。

blocks.en: To further evaluate the accuracy of intrinsic material decomposition, we compare against baselines on objects with ground-truth PBR maps. Given the same clay mesh and reference image, UltraTex more faithfully recovers the target material properties than the multi-view baseline LumiTex and the 3D-native baseline TRELLIS.2, particularly in base color, metallic separation, and spatially varying roughness (Fig. 11 ).
blocks.zh: 为了进一步评价内在物质分解的准确性,我们比较了带有地面真实PBR地图的物体基线。 鉴于同样的粘土网和参考图像,UltraTex比多视图基线LumiTex和3D-本土基线TRELLIS.2更忠实地恢复目标材料属性,特别是在基色、金属分离和空间差异粗糙度(图11)方面。

blocks.en: 4.2.5. Results on Real-World Inputs
blocks.zh: 4.2.5. 关于真实世界投入的成果

blocks.en: We further evaluate UltraTex on casually captured real-world inputs and scanned meshes, including three examples collected from Sketchfab and two from the DTC dataset ( Dong et al., 2025 ) . These inputs exhibit uncontrolled illumination, appearance ambiguity, and imperfect scanned geometry. As shown in Fig. 10 , UltraTex remains robust under these conditions, producing coherent PBR materials and physically plausible relighting. The results demonstrate that our method generalizes beyond clean rendered inputs to practical real-world asset creation.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步评估UltraTex对随机获取的现实世界投入和扫描网格,包括从Sketchfab收集的三个实例和从DTC数据集收集的两个实例(Dong等人,2025年)。 这些投入显示出无节制的照明,外观模糊,扫描几何不完美. 如法智所显. 10, UltraTex在这种条件下仍然坚固,生产了连贯的PBR材料,在物理上可以重新照明. 结果表明,我们的方法超越清洁,为现实世界的实际资产创造提供了投入。

blocks.en: 4.3. Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 4.3. 读取研究

blocks.en: Figure 12. Impact of semantic and photometric alignment . The first row visualizes our VLM adapter capturing intrinsic material semantics. The following rows compare metallic and roughness maps of ablated variants and our full model. Without VLM-derived tokens, the network incorrectly predicts non-metallic surfaces (e.g., painted fish, plastic TV casing) as metallic. Removing photometric alignment yields weaker metallic contrast and fails to recover structural details like gears, rivets, and screws.
blocks.zh: 图 12. 语义和光度校正的影响 第一行可视化我们的VLM适配器,捕捉内在的物质语义. 以下各行比较了稀释变体的金属和粗糙度图和我们的完整模型. 没有VLM衍生的代币,网络将非金属表面(如涂鱼,塑料电视外壳)错误地预测为金属. 消除光度校正产生较弱的金属对比度,无法回收齿轮、螺丝等结构细节。

blocks.en:
To validate the impact of VLM priors, we train a variant of MR estimation network without intrinsic material token guidance.

As shown in Fig. 12 and Tab. 4 , removing the VLM-derived tokens leads to clear material misclassification and increases both metallic and roughness errors.

The ablated model relies heavily on low-level visual cues, such as color and specular highlights, and therefore mistakes strong reflections for metallic materials.
This confirms that VLM guidance provides essential semantic and part-level material priors, enabling more physically grounded MR estimation that is robust to misleading appearance-based heuristics.

In addition, removing the visual conditions also degrades MR quality, demonstrating their complementary role in providing dense spatial guidance for material generation.
blocks.zh:
为了验证VLM Presidents的影响,我们训练一种MR估计网络的变体,没有内在的物质符号指导.

如图12和图4所示,删除从VLM衍生的符号会导致明显的材料分类错误,并增加金属和粗糙度误差。

被放弃的模型严重依赖低水平的视觉提示,如颜色和光谱亮度,因此错误了对金属材料的强烈反射.
这证实,VLM指导提供了基本的语义学和部分层面的材料前传,使得能够对基于外观的休眠论进行更可靠的基于物理的MR估计.

此外,消除视觉条件也会降低MR质量,表明它们在为材料生成提供密集空间引导方面的互补作用.

blocks.en:
To quantify the intrinsic material information encoded by the 1D material tokens, we conduct a decoding probe by replacing the VLM encoder with VAE and DINOv2 encoders under the same setting and directly decoding MR maps from the resulting tokens.
As shown in Tab. 5 , VLM features consistently outperform VAE and DINOv2 features, demonstrating that the resulting tokens carry richer material semantics and better disentangle intrinsic MR properties from observed appearance.
This is because intrinsic material properties require semantic reasoning beyond observable appearance, which is better captured by the world knowledge encoded in VLM representations.
blocks.zh:
为了量化由1D物质符码编码的内在物质信息,我们进行解码探针,在同一个设置下将VLM编码器替换为VAE和DINOv2编码器,并从产生的符码直接解码MR地图.
如塔布所示. 5,VLM的特征一贯优于VAE和DINOv2的特征,表明由此产生的符号带有丰富的物质语义,并更好地将内在MR属性与所观察到的外观分开.
这是因为内在的物质属性要求语义推理超越可观测的外观,这更被编码在VLM表达中的世界知识所捕捉.

blocks.en: Figure 13. VLM-token attention visualization . We visualize the attention map from VLM material tokens to noisy image tokens. The attention maps exhibit clear spatial localization over material-relevant object parts, such as metallic ornaments and hardware, indicating that the 1D material tokens capture part-aware material correspondence.
blocks.zh: 图13. VLM-token可视化 从VLM材料符号到吵闹的图像符号 我们可以看到注意的地图 注意图显示在金属饰品和硬件等与材料相关的物体部分上具有清晰的空间定位,表明1D物质符号捕捉到部分知觉物质对应.

blocks.en: To better understand the part-level spatial localization of the 1D material tokens, we visualize the attention from VLM tokens to noisy image tokens at the 4th layer of the Multi-Modal DiT. As shown in Fig. 13, the responses are strongly localized to material-relevant object parts, such as metallic ornaments, buckles, and other hardware regions. Notably, the VLM tokens themselves carry no explicit spatial coordinates; their spatial correspondence emerges through interaction with the image tokens inside the DiT. This indicates that the material tokens are not merely used as global semantic conditions, but establish part-level correspondence with regions exhibiting the associated material properties.
blocks.zh: 为了更好理解1D物质符号的局部空间定位,我们将VLM符号的注意力直观化为多Modal DiT第4层的噪音图像符号. 如图13所示,对金属饰品、扣扣和其他硬件区域等与材料相关的物体部分的回复是强烈本地化的。 值得注意的是,VLM标志本身没有明显的空间坐标;它们的空间对应通过DiT内部的图像标志的相互作用而出现. 这表明,材料符号不仅被用作全球语义条件,而且与显示相关材料属性的区域建立了部分层面的对应关系。

blocks.en:
To investigate the role of representation level photometric alignment, we compare our full model against a variant trained without this mechanism. As shown in Fig. 12 , removing this constraint causes the model to regress toward conservative averaged values, resulting in less reliable MR predictions. This degradation is especially prominent in roughness estimation, where high-frequency variations on materials such as painted metal, wood, and stone are suppressed.
These results demonstrate that intrinsic reflectance properties cannot be robustly inferred from semantic priors alone; the model requires explicit cues regarding surface response to illumination. Photometric alignment supplies essential, complementary reflectance information for physically accurate MR estimation.
blocks.zh:
为了调查代表水平光度校正的作用,我们把我们的完整模型与没有这种机制的变体进行比较。 如图12所示,消除这一制约导致模型向保守平均值倒退,导致MR预测的可靠性降低。 这种降解在粗糙度估计中尤其突出,在粗糙度估计中,涂装金属,木材,石料等材料的高频变异被抑制.
这些结果表明,不能仅仅从语义学前言中有力地推断出内在反射特性;该模型要求在表面对照明的反应方面有明确的提示。 光度校正为物理上准确的MR估算提供了必要的补充反射信息。

blocks.en:
To evaluate the impact of our joint prediction strategy, we compare our model against a baseline trained solely on albedo.
As shown in Fig. 4 , omitting joint shading-normal estimation leads to visibly smoother albedo maps and weaker surface structures, especially around fine engravings and material boundaries.
This confirms that joint generation is essential for preserving rich, high-frequency surface details, and significantly enhances the visual realism of the final renderings through these enriched surface bump.
blocks.zh:
为了评估我们联合预测战略的影响,我们把我们的模型与仅接受反照率训练的基线进行比较。
如图4所示,略去联合阴影-正常估计会导致明显平滑的反照率图和较弱的表面结构,特别是在细刻图和材料边界周围。
这证实了联合生成对于保存丰富,高频的表面细节至关重要,并且通过这些浓缩的表面凸起大大增强了最终渲染的视觉现实性.

blocks.en: Table 6. VAE reconstruction quality. We evaluate reconstruction fidelity on 366 MR view-maps using the RGB-pretrained VAE.
blocks.zh: 表6. VAE重建质量. 我们用RGB预选的VAE 来评估366 MR视图图上的重建忠诚度.

blocks.en:
MatLat ( Yeo et al., 2026 ) points out a domain gap between general-purpose image VAE latent spaces and material-property distributions. This issue is also relevant to our framework, as we exploit an image-model prior and encode metallic–roughness (MR) maps with an RGB-pretrained VAE.
We therefore compute standard VAE reconstruction metrics on 366 MR view maps by comparing the original and reconstructed MR maps.
As shown in Tab. 6 , although the VAE is not specifically trained for PBR material maps, our evaluation shows that it retains the key material information with minimal reconstruction distortion, supporting its use for MR generation in our framework.
blocks.zh:
MatLat(Yeo等人,2026年)指出了通用图像VAE潜在空间和物质财产分布之间的域间隙。 这个问题也与我们的框架有关,因为我们利用一个图像模型,先用金属色(MR)图,再用预装的VAE。
因此,我们在366 MR视图地图上通过比较原版和重构的 MR 地图来计算标准 VAE 重建指标.
如塔布所示. 6,虽然VAE没有为PBR材料地图专门培训,但我们的评价显示它保留了关键的材料信息,重建扭曲程度最小,支持它用于我们框架内的MR生成.

blocks.en: 4.4. Applications

Figure 14. Multi-view input pipeline . Our framework naturally extends to multi-view references by independently encoding each input view and pairing its image features with the corresponding geometry tokens in the Multi-Modal DiT, while leaving the remaining generation pipeline unchanged.
blocks.zh: 图14. 多视图输入管道 我们的框架自然延伸至多视图参考,方法是独立编码每个输入视图,并将其图像特征与多摩尔DiT中相应的几何符号配对,同时让其余的生成管道保持不变.

blocks.en:
Multi-view references are common in practical content-creation workflows, as they provide complementary observations of object appearance and reduce ambiguity in occluded regions and material properties. As illustrated in Fig. 14 , our framework can be naturally extended to support multi-view inputs with only a minor modification to the Multi-Modal DiT, while leaving the remaining generation pipeline unchanged.
Specifically, given a set of reference images { 𝑰 i } i = 1 N \{\bm{I}_{i}\}_{i=1}^{N} , we construct an image token for each view by replacing Eq. 2 with (15) 𝐓 img i = Linear img ​ [ ℰ VAE ​ ( 𝑰 i ) ; DINOv2 ⁡ ( 𝑰 i ) ] , \mathbf{T}_{\mathrm{img}}^{i}=\mathrm{Linear}_{\mathrm{img}}\left[\mathcal{E}_{\mathrm{VAE}}(\bm{I}_{i});\operatorname{DINOv2}(\bm{I}_{i})\right], where each reference view is independently encoded into its corresponding appearance representation. We then pair the image token with the geometry token of the same view and perform multi-modal fusion as (16) 𝒛 i l 1 = MM ​ - ​ T l 1 ⁡ ( 𝒛 i , 𝐓 img i , 𝐓 geo i ) . \bm{z}_{i}^{l_{1}}=\operatorname{MM\text{-}T}^{l_{1}}\left(\bm{z}_{i},\mathbf{T}_{\mathrm{img}}^{i},\mathbf{T}_{\mathrm{geo}}^{i}\right). This view-wise formulation preserves the original architecture and enables the model to incorporate complementary appearances from multiple observations with minimal changes to the original pipeline.

多视图引用在实际内容创建工作流程中很常见,因为它们对对象外观提供了互补的观测,并减少了在占有区域和物质属性中的模糊性. 如图14所示,我们的框架可以自然扩展,支持多视图输入,仅略微修改多摩达尔DiT,而其余的一代管道保持不变。
具体来说,给定一组参考图像 {Ii}i = 1 N \{\bm{I}_{i}\}_{i=i=i}^{N} ,我们通过将 Eq. 2 替换为 (15) T img i = Linear img [E VAE (I i i ); DINov2 ⁡ (I i i )] ,\ mathbf{ mathrm{ img}}^{i} mathrm{ Linear}_{\ mathrm{ img}}\left [\mathcal{ E}_{\mathrm{ VAE}}(\bm{I}_{i }]] 来为每个视图构建一个图像符号;\operatorname{DINOv2}(\b{I}_{i}\right],其中每个参考视图独立编码为相应的外观代表。 然后,我们将图像符号与同一视图的几何符号配对,并以(16) z i 1 = MM - T l 1 ⁡ (z i, T img i, T geo i ) 进行多模式聚变. \bm{zi}^{l_{1}操作器名{MM\text{}}T}^{l_{1}}\左(\bm{zi}),\mathbf{T}_{\mathrm{img}}^{i},\mathbf{T}_{\mathrm{geo}}^{i}\右). 这种面向视图的配方保留了原有的架构,使模型能够包含从多个观测得到的互补外观,对原有管道的改动最小.

blocks.en: Figure 15. Normal map transformation . Our predicted shading normals are converted to a tangent-space normal map, adding fine-scale surface details to the original clay mesh without modifying its geometry.
blocks.zh: 图15. 普通地图转换 我们预测的阴影常态被转换成切换-空间常态图,在原粘土网上添加精细的表面细节,而不修改其几何.

blocks.en: Our predicted shading normals can be directly converted into a standard tangent-space normal map using the local surface frame of the mesh. As shown in Fig. 15 , applying the resulting normal map to the original clay mesh enriches its shading with fine-scale surface details without modifying the underlying geometry. In particular, subtle structures such as the helmet engravings, facial details, and hair strands become substantially more pronounced, producing a more detailed and realistic surface appearance.
blocks.zh: 我们预测的阴影常态可以直接转换成标准切线-空间常态图,使用网格的局部表面框架. 如图15所示,对原始粘土网块应用所形成的普通地图,用细度的表面细节丰富其阴影,而不修改基本的几何结构。 特别是,头盔雕刻,面部细节,毛线等微妙的结构变得显著得多,产生了更详细更现实的表面外观.

blocks.en: Figure 16. Failure Cases . Highly stylized assets may use MR for artistic rather than physical effects, leading to ambiguous decomposition, as seen in the joker’s hair and the character’s garments. In addition, effects beyond the opaque metallic–roughness model, such as the vehicle’s transparent windshield, cannot be faithfully represented.
blocks.zh: 图 16. 失败案件。 高度刻板化的资产可能利用MR进行艺术效果而不是物理效果,导致模棱两可的分解,如小丑的头发和人物的服装所见. 此外,不透明的金属槽模型之外的效果,如车辆的透明挡风玻璃,不能被忠实地反映。

blocks.en: 4.5. Failure Cases
blocks.zh: 4.5. 失败案件

blocks.en: Our main failure mode arises on highly stylized UGC assets, where PBR attributes are often manipulated to achieve a desired artistic appearance rather than to faithfully represent physical material properties. In particular, metallic may serve as an appearance control for highlights, contrast, or stylized reflectance, making the decomposition fundamentally ambiguous from appearance alone. As shown in Fig. 16 , the joker’s hair and the character’s garments exhibit simultaneously high metallic and roughness values—an artistically plausible choice that does not correspond to their physical material identity. Our predictions may therefore remain visually and physically plausible while differing from such intentionally non-physical reference values. A separate limitation arises from material effects beyond our current PBR parameterization: for example, the transparent windshield of the stylized vehicle in Fig. 16 cannot be faithfully represented by the opaque metallic–roughness model.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要失败模式产生于高度结构化的UGC资产,其中PBR属性经常被操控以实现理想的艺术外观,而不是忠实地代表物理物质属性. 特别是,金属可以用作亮度,对比度,或结构化反射的外观控制,使分解自外观上从根本上模糊不清. 如图16所示,小丑的头发和人物的服装同时展现出高金属和粗糙的价值观——从艺术角度讲,这种选择是合理的,不符合其物质特征。 因此,我们的预测可能在视觉上和物理上都是合理的,但与这种有意的非物理参考值不同。 另外一个限制来自我们目前的PBR参数化以外的物质效应:例如,图16中的型号飞行器的透明挡风玻璃不能用不透明的金属槽模型来忠实地表示。

blocks.en: 5. Conclusions
blocks.zh: 5.五. 结论

blocks.en:
We presented UltraTex, a cascaded multi-view framework for single-image PBR texture generation that moves beyond appearance matching by aligning physical knowledge with diffusion-based material generation.
By integrating a VLM-guided intrinsic material adapter for part-wise semantic priors and photometric representation alignment for material-light interaction, UltraTex generates high-fidelity metallic and roughness maps with improved physical plausibility and relighting behavior.
In addition, joint estimation of world-space shading normals with albedo provides geometry-aware supervision, enriching surface detail and improving albedo fidelity.
Comprehensive evaluations on diverse assets demonstrate that UltraTex substantially outperforms existing open-source and commercial methods in visual fidelity, material accuracy, and physical plausibility, highlighting its potential for high-quality 3D asset creation.
blocks.zh:
我们提出了UltraTex,这是一个用于单像PBR纹理生成的级联多视图框架,它通过使物理知识与传播材料生成相匹配而超越外观匹配。
通过将一个VLM制导的内在材料适配器用于部分智能语义前缀和光度表示对齐用于材料光相互作用,UltraTex生成高纯度金属和粗糙度图,其物理可信度和再亮行为得到改善.
此外,用反照率共同估计世界-空间遮蔽正常情况,提供了几何感知监督,丰富了表面细节,提高了反照率。
对各种资产的全面评价表明,UltraTex公司在视觉忠实、物质准确性和物理可信性方面大大超过现有的开放源码和商业方法,突出了其创造高质量三维资产的潜力。

blocks.en:
Despite its strong generative capability, UltraTex still faces challenges with complex materials involving non-standard light transport.
For example, as shown in Fig. 18 , the model may approximate gemstones using albedo patterns and low roughness values, but cannot faithfully represent transparency, translucency, caustics, or more detailed BRDF effects.
This limitation stems partly from the restricted material channels used in current training data, which focus on albedo, metallic, and roughness.
A promising direction is to incorporate additional material channels, such as specular, coat, transmission, and subsurface scattering, once sufficiently large-scale datasets with such annotations become available.
Another direction is to extend the framework toward more expressive material models while preserving the robustness and scalability of multi-view PBR generation.
blocks.zh:
尽管UltraTex具有很强的遗传能力,但它仍然面临着涉及非标准轻型运输的复杂材料的挑战。
例如,如图18所示,该模型可能使用反照率模式和低粗糙度值来估计宝石,但不能忠实地代表透明度,透明性,致病性,或更为详细的BRDF效应.
这一限制部分源于当前培训数据所采用的限制物质渠道,这些渠道侧重于反照率、金属和粗糙度。
一个有希望的方向是,一旦有了附有说明的足够大规模数据集,就纳入更多的材料渠道,例如光谱、涂料、传输和地下散射。
另一个方向是将框架扩展至更具表现力的材料模型,同时保持多视图PBR生成的稳健性和可扩展性.
